liquidity.two_pct_depth_unresponsive_note: ⚠️ NOT SIZE-RESPONSIVE: every rung from $1,000,000 to $50,000,000 beyond the reference rung returned 0.00bps to within 0.1bp. The quote path is not responding to size, so this bounds nothing -- the same call would clear any number. Real capacity is set by the venue's fixed-rate pocket, which this ladder does not measure.
liquidity.two_pct_depth_basis: ⚠️ NOT SIZE-RESPONSIVE: every rung from $1,000,000 to $50,000,000 beyond the reference rung returned 0.00bps to within 0.1bp. The quote path is not responding to size, so this bounds nothing -- the same call would clear any number. Real capacity is set by the venue's fixed-rate pocket, which this ladder does not measure. A FLOOR, not a measurement. The deepest rung quoted ($50,000,000) still clears inside 200bps, so the crossing is somewhere above where we look. Publishing it as '2% depth' would read as a limit we found. SLIPPAGE CONVENTION: TOTAL over the fill (not marginal impact at the margin), measured against this venue's own smallest quoted rung. ⚠️ That reference EXCLUDES the smallest rung's own spread, so the figure is price impact and NOT the holder's all-in cost — which is fill_ratio (output_usd / size). Both are real and they answer different questions. The same ladder classifies differently under total vs marginal and under impact vs all-in, so both halves are stated for cross-producer comparison.
